notes.notes: [p]Patch 2.0.20. contains bug fixes. See the details down below.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Theatre puzzle: levers do not rotate when interacting with them using a controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Spike puzzle: the instructions on the book on the map table read "start from the east", while it should be "start from the west".[/p][/*][*][p]Matchmaking/connection issue at starting screen: players get stuck in an authentication loop after pressing "return to the title screen" in a post leave pop-up.[/p][/*][*][p]Matchmaking issue in the lobby: closing the game while in-game and remaking the lobby causes a ready desync.[/p][/*][*][p]Text loading issue: loading in from a checkpoint always displays the voice chat tutorial text.[/p][/*][*][p]Walkie-talkie issue: player 2's walkie-talkie will react as if player 1 is talking while player 1 holds down the voice button before they pick up the walkie-talkie.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patching in! New Update released
notes.notes:
[h1]”Can you read me??”[/h1]
[b]“Loud and clear! Over!”[/b] As you may have noticed, we have updated We Were Here on Steam! This patch implements a new voice-chat system called Vivox. This should improve communication between explorers using their walkie-talkies, especially those trapped in Castle Rock!
You also might notice that when booting up We Were Here, the main menu has received a bit of a facelift! Not only is it looking better, it will also keep you up to date with what’s going on with the We Were Here Series… speaking of which… 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/3dc2da813367c0b8fc45e9258514d385986cbfb0.jpg[/img]
[h2]Wear it like you mean it[/h2]
We have opened up our brand new merchandise store! There is an even better way to explore Castle Rock when you look the part with your co-op partner! There are different lines of designs, like our simple yet straightforward [b]TMG Essentials[/b] designs. Our [b]TMG FOR FRIENDS[/b] is there for those who want to relive those memories of being trapped and spending a lot of valuable time together. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/5c7a2d1342c730cc769b100bed398427537c3a0f.png[/img]
But there is [b]limited[/b] merchandise as well! Such as [b]Curse of Castle Rock[/b] pieces of merch as well as [b]Holiday[/b]-related sweaters to keep you and your co-op partner warm!  These lines of merchandise are available until January 31st! 
Can’t wait to get your own merch? Go to http://www.totalmayhemmerch.com
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/773fbc1acfbc56f922c97fbd755a3c7efa2a8238.png[/img]
[h2]Ho Ho Hold on![/h2]
The explorers sure like to celebrate whenever there is a good occasion to do so! If you explore the basecamp in [b]We Were Here Together[/b], you might find them eating some treats based on a Dutch tradition called ‘Sinterklaas’. Can you find all of them? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/8d25191f160e039e2486f4ae5607053ca9484050.gif[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/865360/We_Were_Here_Together/
There’s also a door on the basecamp that’s yet to be opened… I wonder if there’s something lurking behind that as well… 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/8c5368d9173a8a79f0b172e05c13a014fcf0929a.png[/img]

notes.title: We Were Here Together release date set for October 10th!
notes.notes:
It’s time to book an Antarctic vacation, as We Were Here Together will officially be released this [b] October 10th![/b]
https://youtu.be/ReMEdKmfO3I 
We’ve put out a lot of teasers on our social media already (check out [url=https://twitter.com/WeWereHereGame]our Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/totalmayhemgames]our Instagram[/url] if you haven’t already) but here are the most exciting things about the new game… with pictures!

[h1]Explore… outside of Castle Rock for the first time![/h1]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592243/c45e7bb15ccd5d661462a012e98b780924805539.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592243/c45e7bb15ccd5d661462a012e98b780924805539.png[/img][/url] 

[h1]Explore… all new areas inside Castle Rock![/h1]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592243/51bb4bf91af8057f9dea8083811b37a1a649c144.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592243/51bb4bf91af8057f9dea8083811b37a1a649c144.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Explore… and discover equipment in addition to the walkie-talkie![/h1]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592243/1d9e7828d8163f17d47844f5f02c57f05f3ad82e.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592243/1d9e7828d8163f17d47844f5f02c57f05f3ad82e.jpg[/img][/url]

You can already [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/865360/We_Were_Here_Together/]add the game to your wishlist![/url]

[h1]The We Were Here series on Xbox One[/h1]
For those of you with consoles, or console owning friends, we’re happy to announce that the [i]We Were Here series[/i] is coming to Xbox One! More specifically:
[*][i]We Were Here[/i] will be released on September 16th, and will be free to Xbox Live Gold members until October 15th.
[*][i]We Were Here Too[/i] will be released not much later. 
[*]And [i]We Were Here Together[/i]? It will be coming, though after the PC release.[/list]
Lots to look forward to! We’re already preparing to share more teasers and other fun details with you all – watch this space!

Join us on [url=discord.gg/wewerehereseries]our Discord channel[/url] (also great for matchmaking!), follow the news on [url=https://twitter.com/WeWereHereGame]our Twitter[/url] or learn more about our team on [url=https://www.instagram.com/totalmayhemgames]Instagram![/url]

[h1]Before you go… how about this [url= https://kuula.co/post/7qcR0]360 image?[/url][/h1]

notes.title: Update on We Were Here and We Were Here Too
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce the largest performance update for [i]We Were Here[/i] so far! If you haven’t played the game yet or had any issues preventing you from doing so in the past; now is the time!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27599300/e7e4bb37fff385514f56fcf2a1d23692d0435d80.png[/img]

Development of [i]We Were Here Too[/i] is coming along nicely and we’re hoping to release the game in the upcoming months. The store page will be live sometime later this weekend too!

Don’t hesitate to contact us or share your thoughts with us on We Were Here or We Were Here Too! We can be contacted through our social media pages and our website, where you will also find our new [url=http://totalmayhemgames.com/dev-blog-update-1/]Development Blog![/url] The changes made in this patch are numerous, so more detailed information on this can be found here.
We'll also be posting more in-depth details about the design and development of both We Were Here and We Were Here Too.

One important thing to note is that VR support is [b]temporarily disabled[/b]. We are currently working on implementing full motion controller support for We Were Here for HTC Vive players to enjoy. We're sorry for this inconvenience.

Have fun and let us know what you think!
Total Mayhem Games

notes.title: Patch Notes: Update Four
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Update Four is brought to you from our new office space where we'll be working on We Were Here for the upcoming months! If you still experience an issue that is listed or new issues have presented themself please let us know in the discussions.

Thank you for playing "We Were Here",
Total Mayhem Games

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*] Overal stability Voice system
    [*] Server browser no longer scrolls to infinity
    [*] Ingame menu will no longer show when leaving from an inspectable state
    [*] Water SFX are now properly linked to audio options
    [*] Wind audio now linked to SFX instead of Music volume
    [*] Bloom for VR is disabled by default
    [*] Fixed a crash in the main menu for players with a slower connection
    [*] Some doors will no longer be interactable after being opened
    [*] Interaction distance for the chess game has been increased
    [*] Players can no longer turn the handles without locking into them
    [*] The text above the "Play Scene" button now updates properly
    [*] Microphone should regain focus after disconnecting/connecting the device
    [*] The current resolution is now be displayed properly in the options menu
    [*] The options menu is now more user friendly
    [*] Player movement and camera look are properly locked when browsing the ingame menu
    [*] Snow is now less demanding and should not bounce around anymore
    [*] Players should now always start loading at the same time
    [*] Disabled most rooms by default, they will be enabled on the run
    [*] Checkpoints should no longer reset
    [*] Matchmaking code is refactored and should smooth out the experience (let us know if any issues arise)
    [*] Fixed a bug where players got stuck on a blackscreen with fire sound effects
[/list]

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
    [*] The options menus have been reworked
    [*] Voice calibration, located under audio options
    [*] You can now select your microphone in the audio options
    [*] "Play Scene" button is now a lever
    [*] Back/Escape as navigation options in the ingame menu
    [*] Several performance improvements
    [*] Added occlusion culling
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: Update Three
notes.notes:
22 February 2017

As of today some new features have been implemented in the game as we continue to make it more stable. In this patch note we will highlight a couple of important fixes and features listed below. 

Patch Notes

Fixes:
- Added a warning message when there is no microphone connected
- Several Colliders added to avoid players from going out of bounds
- You can no longer sneak past the marionette
- Theatre audio will now synchronise with audio settings
- Roaming audio won't stop playing after skipping intro
- Fixed a bug where the film role wasn't interactable after dropping it
- You can now click on a chesspiece to attack it, instead of the tile below it

Added:
- The last sentence of the theatre puzzle has finally been added
- You can now hear a snow storm in the final room
- Several visual improvements like the player model
- A new Room has been added for VR players when in the menu

We are aware that not all bugs might have been fixed (such as the walkie-talkie in some cases), but since we’ve already made some progress we wanted to share this with you. We would also like to thank the community for embracing our game, reporting issues and overall helping us make the game even better!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Update Two
notes.notes:
We are rolling out a new update that fixes several issues and adds a much-requested feature.We will continue to improve the stability of the game with future updates.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Improved interaction with handles in the theater
    [*]Theater now resets properly after each correct play
    [*]Theater plays can no longer be cheated
    [*]Escape hatch in theater should no longer clip through wall
    [*]Several Colliders added to avoid players from going out of bounds
    [*]Interaction with books has been improved
[/list]

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
   [*]You can now start from checkpoints (they need to be unlocked)
   [*]The puppet in the theater just got a whole lot scarier
   [*]People you have played with should be visible in Recently Played (Steam)
[/list]

Thank you for playing We Were Here!

[i]
I've seen several posts about the theater, the solutions given in the guide are no longer correct. Some solutions given in the guide were marked as correct due to a bug.
[/i]

[i]We are aware several players are having trouble launching the game, we are doing our best to solve this problem.[/i]

notes.title: Patch notes: Update One
notes.notes:
[b]We would like to thank everyone for playing We Were Here![/b]

We are aware of some of the issues some players might be having and are monitoring the discussions to see what other issues arise. Below you will find a list of issues that have been fixed for this first patch.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]Fixes[/b] 
[list]
    [*]Resolved a crash issue related to a certain checkpoint
    [*]Improved interaction distance for certain objects
    [*]Inspecting books in VR should no longer spawn the player on random locations
    [*]Added colliders in several places to avoid players going out of bounds
    [*]Chess pieces are now a little easier to see
    [*]Fixed several textures
    [*]Total room limit has been increased
[/list]

[b]Added[/b] 
[list]
    [*]You can now inspect the portrait in the Study room
[/list]

We are also looking into some of the feature requests posted in the reviews/discussions to see if we can make these happen.[spoiler]Save game perhaps :)[/spoiler]

Again a big thank you from the We Were Here team, if you have more feedback or feature requests you can post them in the Steam discussions.
